scope: training reviewed events and length-matched controls only; no validation, held-out, or critical method output read
selection_rule: purity-first lexicographic ranking: false-merge proxy rate/count, female observed tracklet changes, false-break proxy rate, female retention, overall retention, then conservative deterministic tie-breaks
proxy_limits: False-merge and false-break fields are motion/reciprocity proxies, not labeled biological errors.
Female annotations are sparse and cannot expose male-to-male swaps.
A lower proxy count can result from abstention; retained coverage and unresolved fraction must be read alongside it.
Temporal controls are length-matched, not behavior- or risk-matched.
